description: The host's Claude and Codex subscription accounts (hostaccounts): list them; add one (Claude: name and an existing signed-in config folder, or name and token where the host has no claude; Codex: name and an existing signed-in home); rename one (id, name); replace a token account's token (id, token); remove one (id); select a provider's default for new chats (provider, id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); use another for a chat (session, id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in: its agent started again under it, resuming the chat, once its turn's over); read a subscription's usage (id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); sign in (sign_in: provider and name for a new account, or id to sign in to one again; Claude's runs claude auth login with the account's own folder, its lines coming as they're written, the page to open among them; Codex's codex login (method: the browser's, by default, or the device code's), its state coming as it goes (login: the page to open, and the device code's code to enter there); then its end; the connection's going stops it); pass a code the sign-in page showed to the sign-in this connection runs (code: no answer of its own); pass the address a browser ended on after a Codex browser sign-in's page to the one this connection runs (callback: url; answered with the page codex's server gave, or error). Each other is answered with accounts.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

provider.description: add, select, sign_in (a new account): whose.

id.description: rename, token, remove, select, use, usage, sign_in: the account ("" for the CLI's own sign-in, select, use and usage only).

session.description: use: the chat whose account it is, one of the host's sessions whose model is the account's provider's. sign_in (a Claude account's) and token: the chat it's for, whose sign-in (ChatLogin) its host moves as it goes, as a login request's, if the asker may read the chat (Agent Management's read).

name.description: add, rename, sign_in (a new account): its name.

token.description: add (Claude), token: a token from claude setup-token.

home.description: add (Codex): an existing CODEX_HOME on the host, signed in with ChatGPT and keeping its credentials in a file.

folder.description: add (Claude): an existing Claude config folder on the host, signed in (claude auth status says so, run with it).

code.description: code: what the sign-in page showed, pasted.

method.description: sign_in, Codex's: browser (the default: codex login, its page sending the browser back to the host's 127.0.0.1) or device (codex login --device-auth).

url.description: callback: the address the browser ended on (its path and query are what's passed on).
